issues.detail: The Greek 'οποιαν εισοδον εχομεν προς υμας' (what entrance we have to you) refers to the spiritual 'entrance' or 'admission' into their fellowship/community. The Vietnamese 'được tiếp đón thế nào' (how we were welcomed) changes the meaning from a state of 'having an entrance' to the action of 'being welcomed'.
